title: Demo settings & data
subtitle: Control this browser’s fictional shop. Export a backup before importing or resetting.
adminOnly: Choose Admin preview to change settings or access complete demo backups. Preview modes are not authentication.
saved: Settings saved. Existing invoices retain their original values.
policy: JSON contains catalogue, embedded images, stock, sessions, drafts, sales and refunds. Maximum 5 MB. Imports replace this demo after validation; they do not merge or restock. CSV import is not included.
confirmBody: All current records will be replaced by this validated file. Export a backup first if you want to keep them.
invalid: Import rejected. Current records are unchanged.
resetBody: This removes local changes and uploads and restores 40 sample designs, two sample sales and two saved bills.
future: Backups belong to this demo only. They are not a production database or accounting export.
downloaded: Backup download started. Keep the JSON file to restore this browser demo later.
